label: Listening lab HL (Audio Technology Lab, ITU-R BS.1116), TU Ilmenau
note: conditions are wall layouts (Roomconfigurations.jpg; walls 2.5 m high, 1.6 cm pressboard): HL00W none added; HL01W front; HL02WL front and right; HL02WP left and right; HL03W front, left and right; HL04W closed rectangle; HL05W rectangle with the rear-left corner cut by a diagonal wall; HL06W L-shaped enclosure; HL08W stepped enclosure with FR outside. Sources m0-m4 = SiL, FC, FR, SiR, BC (Floor_plan.jpg; same order as SourcePosition). Robot always faces x (north). The 8.43 x 7.54 m L-shaped footprint matches the listening lab of tuil_translation_two_rooms (8.4 x 7.6 x 2.8 m). The SRIRs are time-aligned: the direct sound is at about 20.8 ms (sample 1000) in every file, whatever the distance. Every SRIR has a burst that is not noise about 1.35 s after the file start (probably sweep distortion wrapped round by the deconvolution), so the analysis reads only the first 1.25 s
